2.
6 EXT. TEMPLE SPACE - DAY
A traditional dancer dances and worships the idol.
CUT TO:
7 EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - DAY
Two monks are meditating - an older monk and a very young
child. Three people are fighting in front of them, trying to
kill each other. One of them dies and falls at the monk’s
feet. His sword goes through the older monk, killing him. The
child opens his eyes and runs to where the box is. He picks
it up and runs away.
CUT TO:
8 INT. TIBETAN MONASTERY - DAY
The Dalai Lama hands the box to a CIA agent.
CUT TO:
9 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - DAY
A folder is slammed on a desk. On the folder is written
“Kalpa Vigraha” and scribbled next to it is “27000 years old”
CUT TO:
10 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - DAY
The box is put inside a chest and is pushed into a shelf. A
giant bar shuts the door close.
CUT TO:
11 INT. CIA OFFICE, USA - NIGHT
The chest is open. There is nothing inside it. Alarms go off,
red lights everywhere buzzing.
12 CREDITS END.
FADE OUT.
